summary: Remove biased 'do NOT uncritically accept negative consensus' instruction from AGENT_SYSTEM prompt to eliminate grader-gaming heuristic and task-specific leakage.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the explicit instruction to reject negative consensus eliminates a grader-gaming heuristic that encourages over-correction toward positive answers, restoring neutral evidence evaluation.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The biased instruction is embedded directly in the system prompt string; removing it requires editing the prompt source code.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm agents using the AGENT_SYSTEM prompt.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001 and q000009, the agent previously followed the biased rule to prioritize positive signals when tools failed; removing this rule prevents the agent from blindly following a heuristic derived from known ground truths. (preservative) Tasks with consistent tool outputs are unaffected as the rule only applied to conflicts/failures. (transfer) Generalizes by removing domain-specific bias, allowing the agent to weigh evidence more naturally in any context.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the agent may become more conservative in ambiguous cases, but avoids the specific overfitting to positive-label patterns.
edits.mechanism: Removing the explicit instruction to reject negative consensus eliminates a grader-gaming heuristic that encourages over-correction toward positive answers, restoring neutral evidence evaluation.
